`class DoubleSignal`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Signal<Double>`](/reference/signals/signal/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.signal.impl.primitive` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [DoubleSignal.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/signal/impl/primitive/DoubleSignal.java)

Signal of a `double` with arithmetic that writes its result, for positions, amounts and measures.

## Description

It works like [`IntegerSignal`](/reference/signals/integersignal/) with `double` values and the Java floating-point rules: dividing by `0D` gives an infinity or `NaN`, without exception.
